description: Hitachi Energy (ABB) REx5xx REL511 distance zones as a flat REL511 setting sheet prints them (TAP NAME | TAP SETTING | TAP RANGE). Catalog-only. Configured settings: per-zone Operation_Zn (status), DirZn (direction), gated Timer tn / tn, X1Zn (reactive reach), R1Zn, X0Zn / R0Zn, the CT / VT values and the line data. Documented relay behaviour (DEC-198, ABB 1MDB06309-YN, verified): the fixed X/R polygonal (quadrilateral) characteristic and the full-scheme phase-phase / phase-earth loops of every enabled zone -- REL511 exposes no selector for either. Not verified (blocking): the impedance setting basis, the RFZn / RFNZn conversion (preserved, never used), ZnBlock = On on an enabled zone. Not representable: the left / directional boundary and the line-angle-adjusted resistive lines.
interpretation_notes: Zone N is the parameter set ending in ZN (Operation_ZN, X1ZN, R1ZN, X0ZN, R0ZN, RFZN, RFNZN, Timer tN, tN, DirZN, ZNBlock); the numbering follows the sheet.

Documented relay behaviour (ABB 1MDB06309-YN, Line distance protection terminal REL 511): every enabled distance zone has the fixed X/R polygonal (quadrilateral) characteristic and measures the phase-phase and phase-earth loops (full scheme). The reference applies to the REL 511 / REx 5xx distance function by its matching function and parameter structure, not to a confirmed firmware revision.
A 'V<n>' marker in the scheme name is not established as the firmware version (it may be a scheme / template version), so no firmware version is asserted.

Not yet verified: whether the impedance settings are primary or secondary ohms, and how RFZn / RFNZn convert to the plotted resistive boundaries (per loop or per phase). Both are preserved and block; nothing is assumed.

Geometry limitation: the relay adjusts its operate characteristic to the line characteristic angle (ABB 1MDB06309-YN, Fig. 1); the current engine draws vertical resistive limits and does not reproduce this. No left (-R) / directional boundary is representable. No approximation is applied.

zone_preserved.reason: ZnBlock is an On / Off switch whose effect (what it blocks) is not verified; its value is preserved and never interpreted as a zone state.

mappings.note: CTPrim Iphases: the phase CT primary current (no unit printed; amperes).
Ir is the relay's rated current input; it is taken as the CT secondary rating. The sheet does not label it as the CT secondary (the notes' CT ratio agrees). Confirm.
VTPrim Uphases is printed without a unit; kV is assumed (the sheet's 132kV header agrees) and converted to volts. Confirm the unit.
Ur is the relay's rated voltage input; it is taken as the VT secondary rating (volts). The sheet does not label it as the VT secondary. Confirm.
Line Length as printed; its unit is the sheet's 'Length unit'.
R1 / X1 of the line-data group (beside Line Length and the fault-locator source impedances) read as the line's positive-sequence impedance; the sheet's own '1' / '0' naming, not a stated label.
R0 / X0 of the line-data group read as the line's zero-sequence impedance; the sheet's own '1' / '0' naming, not a stated label.
DirZn as printed. A value that is not one of the printed options (Non / Forward / Reverse) is not interpreted.

gap.note: The impedance setting basis (primary or secondary ohms) for this REL511 setting format has not yet been verified.

mappings.note: The sheet states a reactance (X1Zn) and resistances, never a reach angle: the reach is stated as orthogonal R / X values.

mappings.note: REL 511 distance zones have a fixed X/R polygonal (quadrilateral) characteristic (ABB 1MDB06309-YN, Fig. 1, pp. 2-3), applied to an enabled zone. The relay adjusts the operate characteristic to the line characteristic angle; the current engine does not reproduce that inclination.

not_exposed.note: REL511 has no characteristic selector: the X/R polygonal characteristic of its distance zones is fixed relay behaviour.

mappings.note: X1Zn: the zone's positive-sequence reactive reach.
R1Zn: the zone's positive-sequence resistance setting. How the relay uses it is not stated; it does not set a drawn boundary.
R0Zn / X0Zn: the zone's zero-sequence reach. Preserved, not plotted.

gap.note: The source fault-resistance setting ({evidence}) is available, but its conversion to the plotted resistive boundary (per loop or per phase) has not yet been verified. No Right Resistive Reach (+R) is derived from it; the value is preserved here.
No left (-R) resistive boundary is stated for this relay; its left / directional boundary is not yet representable.

The source phase-earth fault-resistance setting ({evidence}) is preserved; its per-loop / per-phase convention has not yet been verified, so it is not used as a resistive reach. The phase-phase engine does not draw it.

requires.off_note: The 'Timer t{n}' switch is Off, so t{n} is not an operating delay of this zone; none is assumed.
requires.missing_note: the 'Timer t{n}' switch was not found, so t{n} is not established as in use

mappings.note: The zone timer, read only while its own 'Timer' switch is On. One delay per zone (phase and earth loops).
